fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-12-26, the seller of a house near Nallur Garden Residential Colony allegedly accepted Rs. 90,000 from the complainant without a clear title. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-12-22 at roughly 17:35. Malathi Devi submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000485. The complaint refers to Siva Selvam, a co-worker, reachable on 9000000440. The complainant alleged that Madhan Murugan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000216. Transactions from the account SYN-ACC-100065, held by the complainant, were referred to in the complaint. The complainant mentioned transaction records, a bank transaction reference and physical documents. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00291, as the mobile number 9000000216 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Transaction record; Bank transaction reference; Physical document
fields.Modus_Operandi: Seller reportedly shared questionable documents and stopped responding.
fields.Keywords: property fraud, cheating, transaction record, bank reference, evening, residential colony, bank account, suspect
